label: SparkShield Monitoring & Tamper Automation
info:
SparkShield Cyber-Physical Smart-Meter Tamper-Detection Pipeline.
Ingests real-time 12-field telemetry frames from Android/Host WebSocket server (ws://<host>:8765/telemetry).
Provides baseline grid monitoring, classification routing (EMP, OPTICAL, SURGE), 5-second rate limiting, connection health tracking, and multi-channel alerting (MQTT, Webhook, Dashboard).
